tasks.title: Stable timestep helper
tasks.prompt: Implement or verify a stable timestep helper that respects a CFL-style dt <= dx / wave_speed bound.
plan: Retrieve examples of timestep helpers and CFL validation before editing.
Keep the helper small and auditable.
Run the CFL scientific validation separately from compilation.

retrieval.query: stable timestep CFL condition finite volume

expected_changes.description: Provide the stable_timestep helper used by tests and validation.

scientific_validation.name: CFL bound
scientific_validation.criterion: dt is positive and no larger than dx / wave_speed
